papers_reviewed.title: Explainable Regime-Aware Investing
papers_reviewed.author: Amine Boukardagha (Columbia University)
papers_reviewed.summary: Wasserstein-HMM with dynamic BIC model-order selection and TC-MVO allocation. Sharpe 2.18 vs 1.18 for SPX B&H, MaxDD -5.43% on cross-asset universe. Directly extends H429.

papers_reviewed.title: Continuous Hidden Markov Models for Equity Returns: Heavy-Tail Emission Families and Regime-Conditional Value-at-Risk
papers_reviewed.author: Alswaidan, Jin, Varner
papers_reviewed.summary: Student-t/Laplace/GE emissions unified under shared forward-backward recursions. Regime-conditional VaR passes conditional coverage tests. On daily US equities, interpretable Markov model with heavy tails suffices.

papers_reviewed.title: Supply Chain Propagation of Textual Signals: LLM Embeddings and Cross-Sectional Return Predictability
papers_reviewed.author: Alswaidan et al.
papers_reviewed.summary: FinBERT 10-K MD&A embeddings propagated via Bloomberg SPLC supply chain graph. Sharpe 0.86, FF5-alpha 7.27%/yr, NW t=-2.64 on 255 S&P 500 firms 2011-2025. Connects to H419 supply chain PEAD secondary watchlist.

papers_reviewed.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
papers_reviewed.author: Yimin Du
papers_reviewed.summary: AdjMSE bias correction for rolling-window factor pipelines on Chinese A-shares. 53.8% sign accuracy vs 51.2% for MSE. Mask-first design for non-tradable prices. China-focused but bias correction pattern transferable.
papers_reviewed.note: China-specific; bias correction patterns already well-covered in our IS/OOS design principles. No new hypothesis needed.

wiki_expansion.reason: Thinnest section: 12 entries vs 210 for Trading. Almost no cross-links to trading strategies or production portfolio. ESG factor signals and impact-quant bridge are missing.
